title: What should be included in a cosmetic packaging RFQ brief? - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge
company: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
product_line_cn: 高端定制彩盒/美妆包装
buyer_question: What should be included in a cosmetic packaging RFQ brief?
buyer_context: skincare jars, serums, beauty sets, retail launch kits and ecommerce cosmetic packs
short_answer: A quote-ready brief should give the supplier enough context to review structure, material, print and packing direction before pricing. For custom cosmetic packaging, MUGE PACKAGING recommends sending product fit and insert structure, retail or ecommerce sales channel, surface finish direction, artwork readiness, shipping protection review, plus artwork status and the target market.
